extension.description: Current weather for a configurable location in the status bar, with details on hover.
configuration.location: Location for the weather display, e.g. `Berlin`, `Munich` or `Freiburg, DE`. The first match is used if there are multiple results. Leave empty to stop fetching weather data. The location is sent to Open-Meteo.
configuration.refreshInterval: Automatic refresh interval in minutes (5 to 120).
